project_type: PHP web app with vanilla JS frontend (no framework)
verification_instructions: Run php -l on both modified files to verify no syntax errors
setup_instructions: No setup needed, PHP 8.4 already available
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no package installs, no Docker. Only AST/syntax validation possible.
key_patterns: Backend: KolekController.php contains migrasiBucketOsc (main matrix+summary) and getMigrasiBucketDetail* (detail modal). Frontend: pages/migrasi_bucket.php has all JS inline. The catBreakdownHtml function renders SC/FE/BE breakdown. The runoff per row is currently computed in JS as Math.max(0, os_m1 - sumNonO).
directory_structure: api/controllers/ - PHP backend controllers; pages/ - PHP frontend pages with inline JS/CSS; api/routes/ - route definitions; api/helpers/ - utility classes
